approval.basis: Hub adjudication of the Codex and Grok open briefs; both seats declined to name a project count or a date because neither is measurable on this machine, and both proposed an event gate instead.

policyIsNotPrintOrder: Slot numbers are a tray-loading convention. The slicer picks the first-layer sequence itself from contour area, and this package writes no first_layer_print_sequence for it to follow.

census.reason: No live project store has been enumerated. A missing census is not a census of zero, and must hold admission rather than permit it.

events: Hub considers admitting the replacement for the 2026-09-08 internal package, carrying the kernel slot/part fix at 292c288b, before that candidate reaches handover
a request to persist a new automatic colour-based slot mapping into a project or revision outside the frozen cohort
doesNotOpenANewWindow: a build made only to test inside a session room, which is not a handover

atCheckpoint.qualifiedGeometricPlanner: allocate new slots by zFirst, then structural block, then hex; preserve saved slots and explicit user choices; do not equate the result with print order
atCheckpoint.plannerMissingOrUnqualified: stop accepting automatic colour-based allocation outside the frozen cohort; new slots must be decided explicitly by the person; if that path is not implemented and verified, hold the dependent operation or package rather than letting the colour allocator continue
atCheckpoint.extensionRequires: a new explicit owner decision, taken on a measured census, with a newly closed scope

countRules.projects: distinct real projectId with committed automatic slot changes
countRules.revisions: distinct real (projectId, projectRevision) with committed automatic slot changes
countRules.newSourceSameProject: new revision if the automatic mapping changes; not a new project
countRules.failedOrPending: record attempts separately; do not count as committed
countRules.fixture: separate named corpus; never counted as real project evidence

doNotCountBy: Counting occurrences of the string rgba-ascending-lowest-compatible-v1 does not measure this. Adoption writes that marker even when it preserves an existing slot, and a colour edit moves a slot through a different path. It traces which policy ran; it is not a counter.
